conventions.anchor: pixel (in sourceSize, render scale) of the bottom corner of the footprint diamond, for every kind incl. terrain tiles; cliff faces: the tile's bottom corner at the top of that step
conventions.terrain: tile frame = variant str((x mod period) + period * (y mod period)); animated water '<index>.<frame>'; cliff faces are one elevationStepPx step, stack them down to the lower tile, use the *_lip variant for the topmost step
conventions.transition: white masks, alpha = how much of the neighbour's ground to draw over this tile; edge_px = neighbour at x+1, corner_px_py = diagonal neighbour at x+1,y+1 (only when neither adjacent edge neighbour matches)
conventions.mask: white RGB, alpha = team colour coverage; tint per player and draw over the frame (multiply or overlay), same sourceSize and anchor
conventions.shadow: black RGB, alpha = shadow; draw on a ground layer below all objects, same sourceSize and anchor
conventions.sun: from screen top-left, shadows fall to the screen right
conventions.gameToBlender: game tile +x = Blender +X, game tile +y = Blender -Y, 1 tile = 1 Blender unit
